title: Record the half that doubles register 292
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 19164, register 295 holds `-1/2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- One addition writes it: event 19156 adds `-1` times register 356, which holds `1/2`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The writes that take register 356 from `1` to `1/2` are not traced.
